Nav.demoText: Numerogram is an early, actively evolving project - some features are still missing, and the design and content are subject to change. Feel free to explore, but expect rough edges.
Nav.supportText: Supporting via Buy Me a Coffee unlocks no premium features. Every coffee turns into an evening of work on the project. If you'd like to help this project move faster, a small donation goes a long way - thank you!
